selection.paired_selection_rule: dev R@5 then MRR; retain zero-shot if adapter does not improve
selection.probe_selection_rule: mean EN/ZH metadata-silver dev nDCG@10; ties prefer lower weight
selection.warning: Silver dev tunes catalog compliance, not independent visual relevance. Test not used.

paired_clip_test.warning: Exact identical captions treated as multi-positive. Captions contain weak metadata supervision; not an independently human-judged relevance test.
